title: Amazing experience!
text: Lilia is a great guide! I had so much fun walking around Barcelona with her, she knows all the hidden gems, nice restaurants and picture perfect spots. She definitely made my experience of Barcelona unforgettable!
author: Fernando K

title: Best experience in Barcelona
text: It was an incredibly interesting tour. Great combination of historical facts, funny facts, some cool shops, food I mean there is nothing I would like to add to this tour. Maybe I just would like to make it even longer. Thank you Lilya! I highly recommend it to everyone who is in Barcelona.

title: Fantastic Private Tour in Barcelona
text:
I just had a private tour in Barcelona with Liliia, and it was the best day of my whole trip. She helped me plan everything and made it perfect for me.
We saw all the famous sights but also found some hidden gems. Liliia showed us around cool neighborhoods like Raval, the Gothic Quarter, and El Born. She shared a lot of interesting history and told great stories that made it really fun.
A nice part of the tour was visiting an art gallery that Liliia picked out. I found some pieces I really liked. She was super helpful and made sure I had a great time.

title: Highly recommend it
text: This tour with friends was absolutely incredible! It wasn’t just the typical sightseeing – we explored unique spots like local designer shops, a hidden vine bar, and even did an olive oil tasting, which was a nice surprise. We also stopped at an art gallery. The guide was super friendly, easy to talk to, and made the whole experience fun and engaging. Nothing felt rushed or boring. It was one of the best ways to experience Barcelona’s local vibe, and we all had a blast! Highly recommend it.
author: X8799SE_

title: Fantastic experience in Barcelona
text: It was a fantastic experience! Our guide Lilya made the day super flexible, taking us to major sites like the Gothic Quarter and some cool hidden spots we wouldn’t have found on our own. We loved the street art, fun stories about the city’s past, and getting a real feel for local life. The tapas break was a nice touch, and the whole day felt relaxed but packed with memorable experiences. Would definitely recommend for a nice day in Barcelona!
author: _O9404WM

title: Awesome and unique way to explore Barcelona
text: One day tour with Liliia is really awesome and unique way to explore for those who are for the first time here and those who have already been in Barcelona. For me that was the second time and Liliia created a tour especially for me. I saw places which I haven’t seen before. We had lunch in a very beautiful place with typical food. Lilya showed me very interesting shops, a lot of art, hidden corners where only locals go. I had a very comprehensive experience. And Lilya is a super nice person, I felt like I was walking with a friend.
author: Dmitry_V
